Agent response: That's a very good question, and it's helpful to know what to expect with tracking updates. It's not uncommon for there to be pauses in the tracking journey. Here’s a breakdown of what might be happening and what to do: Initial Activation: First, please keep in mind that it can take 24-72 business hours for tracking events to appear after you first receive your tracking ID. Silence During Transit: Our shipping partner, DHL, handles the long-haul transport. It is completely normal for tracking to go silent for a few days while your package is traveling between their hubs, as they don't scan it during this phase. Handoff to USPS: Once the package reaches your local area, DHL hands it off to USPS for the final delivery. After this handoff, it can take another 12-24 hours for the first scan from USPS to appear in their system. If you see that DHL has handed off the package but more than 48 hours have passed with no new updates from USPS, please let our support team know. They can open a trace to investigate the location of your package. You can reach them at support@primalharvest.com. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
